fruit.definition: The part of a plant that grows from a flower and often holds seeds.

grain.definition: A small hard seed from a grass plant grown for food.

powder.definition: Dry material made up of very small separate pieces.

flour.definition: Powder made by breaking grain into very small pieces, used to make food.

bread.definition: A food made from flour and water worked together, often baked in an oven.

dough.definition: A thick soft material made by working flour and water or another liquid together, which can be shaped before it is cooked.
